regulations.occupancy_limits: Maximum of 4 unrelated persons (per zoning district rules for the dwelling unit)
regulations.enforcement_body: City of Golden Community and Economic Development
regulations.notes: Golden requires a Special Use Permit for STRs ('tourist homes'). Occupancy is limited to 4 unrelated persons per dwelling. The city considered a moratorium in 2018 while studying regulations. Verify current permit requirements and fees with the City of Golden.
